query.postgres: select string_agg(employee::varchar, ';') as employees from ( select distinct vacationinfo.employee from dirrx_nnvacat_vacationsinfor as vacationinfo join sungero_core_recipient as employee on employee.id = vacationinfo.employee where vacationinfo.vacationschedu = {0} and (not vacationinfo.consenthrpro or vacationinfo.consenthrpro is null) and vacationinfo.status = 'Active' and employee.status = 'Active' and not exists (select 1 from sungero_content_edoc as doc where doc.documentkind_docflow_sungero = {1} and doc.vacationschedu_overrid_dirrx = {0} and doc.employeedirrx_overrid_dirrx = vacationinfo.employee) limit {2} ) as employee
